Players now have faces. Every list on the **Players** tab (online, whitelist, operators and bans) shows each player's head, with the hat layer, next to their name. Flytower fetches skins from Mojang itself and keeps them on disk under `/var/lib/flytower/skins`, so your browser never tells a third-party avatar site who plays on your server, a player's skin is checked again only once a day, and heads keep showing when Mojang is down. Offline-mode and unknown players get the default Steve or Alex head without anything being sent to Mojang.

The message of the day has a proper editor. **Game settings** now has two lines with a toolbar for the 16 colours and bold, italic, underline, strikethrough and obfuscated text, and a live preview of how the server looks in Minecraft's multiplayer list, which warns when a line is too long and would be wrapped or cut off. **Show codes** shows the raw `§` codes for anyone who'd rather type them. The MOTD is still the same `motd:` string in YAML, so specs, clones and imports are unchanged, and an MOTD with codes written by hand opens already formatted.

Testing notes are in the "Player heads" and "MOTD editor" sections of [testing-1.2.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.1/docs/testing-1.2.0.md).
